ns2:course.label: Commercial - Instrument II
ns2:course.description: Second of a two course sequence to prepare the private pilot for the instrument rating. Includes forty-five hours classroom instruction on advanced maneuvers, aerodynamics, navigation, and aircraft systems. Includes 30.2 hours of flight training and 8 hours in a flight simulator in the flight laboratory. Students enrolling in this course will also participate in up to 5 hours of research flight experiments. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: AVI 130 and consent of director.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: AVI 130 and consent of director.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Additional Flight Fee is Required. Departmental approval by Chief of Pilot Training is required. Students must register for one lecture-discussion and one flight section.
